$comment: Single source for `cargo xtask load` (architecture §11, TEST-CONCURRENT): xtask starts the database and runs the driver; the driver, a Node program, reads the same file for the name of the variable that carries the address of the PostgreSQL database and for the defaults. The short run is the one `cargo xtask ci` makes on both databases; the long one (`--long`) is made by hand at the exit of a milestone on a quiet computer. Every run makes a backup through the route at its middle, and afterwards xtask restores it into a second database ('restoredName' on PostgreSQL, a second data folder on SQLite) and judges that copy too.
